info.title: pingtxt API
info.summary: REST API of the pingtxt hub.
info.description:
Everything the web UI does goes through this API.

## Authentication

Create a personal token in **settings → api tokens** and send it as a bearer token:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ptk_..." https://status.example.com/api/monitors
```

- **read** tokens can call every `GET` endpoint marked *read*.
- **write** tokens can also create, change and delete. Only admins can create them.
- Account and instance settings (users, tokens, 2FA, settings, backups) need a browser session: tokens get `403`.

## Roles

Admins can change everything. **Viewers** are read-only: every request that is not `GET` answers `403`, and secrets in monitors and notification channels are replaced by `********`.

## Conventions

- Bodies are JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`); other content types on writes get `415`.
- Times are Unix milliseconds. Ids are integers.
- Errors are `{"error": "message"}` with a 4xx/5xx status.
- Browser requests from another origin are refused (`403`).

AI assistants can use the same API through the MCP server on `/mcp`.

SVG badge with the overall state of a status page (operational, degraded, partial outage, major outage), to embed in a README:

```markdown
![status](https://pingtxt.example.com/api/badge/acme/status.svg)
```

**Access:** No authentication. Only published status pages and the monitors they show have badges; anything else answers the same 404 badge. Also served on the page's custom domain. Cached for 60 seconds.

parameters.description: Slug of a published status page.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Replaces the left text (up to 60 characters).

get.description:
SVG badge of one monitor shown on a published status page: its state (`status`), its uptime (`uptime`) or its average response time (`response`) over `period`. The label defaults to the monitor name, `uptime 30d` or `response 24h`.

```markdown
![uptime](https://pingtxt.example.com/api/badge/acme/12/uptime.svg?period=7d)
```

**Access:** No authentication. Only published status pages and the monitors they show have badges; anything else answers the same 404 badge. Also served on the page's custom domain. Cached for 60 seconds.

200.description: Sent to at least one channel.

bearerAuth.description: Personal API token from settings → api tokens.

Unauthorized.description: Not logged in, or the token is invalid or expired.

Forbidden.description: Not allowed for this role, token scope or kind of authentication.

example.error: a group with this name already exists

BadGateway.description: The notification could not be delivered.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many failed attempts. Password logins are limited to 10 failures per account and 30 per client address in 15 minutes; second factor codes to 10 wrong codes per user. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a new attempt is accepted.

example.error: too many failed attempts, try again in 14 minutes

created_at.description: Unix time in milliseconds (0 = never / unknown).

scope.description: read: GET requests only. write: everything a token can do.

created_at.description: Unix time in milliseconds (0 = never / unknown).

last_used_at.description: Unix time in milliseconds (0 = never / unknown).

path.description: Path in the JSON body: dot notation with [n] for array items, e.g. data.items[0].status.

value.description: Expected value. Not used by exists / not_exists; a number for gt/gte/lt/lte; a regular expression for matches.

Assertion.description: A rule on the JSON body of an http or keyword response.

target.description: What to check, depends on the type: an http(s) URL (http, keyword, mcp), host:port (tcp, IPv6 in brackets: [2001:db8::1]:443), a hostname or IP (ping, dns), a connection URL (postgres://, mysql://, redis://, mongodb://), a container name or id (docker), grpc[s]://host:port[/service], smtp[s]://host[:port]. Empty for push.

interval_sec.description: Seconds between checks, 10 to 86400 (push: expected period, up to 7 days). 0 = default (60, push 3600).

retries.description: Consecutive failures before a location counts as down, 1 to 10.

method.description: HTTP method for http/keyword (default GET). For mcp: the transport, auto, streamable or sse.

expected_status.description: Accepted HTTP status codes, e.g. "200-299" or "200,301". For mcp: the minimum number of tools.

keyword.description: keyword: text that must appear in the body. mcp: comma separated tool names that must be listed.

keyword_invert.description: keyword: fail when the text is found.

dns_record.description: dns: record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS...).

dns_server.description: dns: resolver to query, host[:port]. Empty = system resolver.

dns_expected.description: dns: value that must be in the answer.

ip_family.description: Check over IPv4 only (4), IPv6 only (6) or either (0, default). Without it, a dual-stack target passes when either family works. Ignored for push and docker.

assertions.description: JSON response rules, http and keyword only, at most 20.

grace_sec.description: push: extra time after the period before the monitor goes down, 0 to 86400.

degraded_pct.description: Share of failing locations (percent) from which the monitor is degraded, 1 to 50. 0 = instance default.

locations.description: Where the check runs: "local" (the hub) and/or "agent:<id>". Empty = local. See GET /api/locations.

cert_expiry_alert.description: Alert before the TLS certificate expires (https targets).

domain_expiry_alert.description: Alert before the domain registration expires.

paused.description: Create the monitor paused. Ignored on update: use POST /api/monitors/{id}/pause.

push_token.description: push: token of the heartbeat URL. Hidden from read-only users.
